Viet Cong Tours

Family-run local tours of the Hà Giang Loop

Small Groups, Genuine Local Experiences

Our tours are designed for groups of 4–10 people, whether you’re travelling with friends and family or have met fellow travellers along the way and decided to explore Hà Giang together.

If you’re looking to experience the Hà Giang Loop without joining large groups of 30–40 people, we’re here for you. We keep our groups small so you can enjoy a more personal, relaxed and authentic experience, giving you the opportunity to connect with the local people, discover places beyond the usual tourist stops and experience the area at a more natural pace.

We’re not about rushing through the Loop with a big crowd. We’re about sharing our home with you.

Meet your guide

Hi, I’m Cong from Hà Giang. This is my home and my family’s home. I run these tours with my wife Lilly, our family and friends. We guide small groups with care and honesty. No big company, just us. We know these roads, these villages, and these families.

We keep groups small, so we can share real life, not rush. People come as guests, leave as family.

Moments from our tours

Rooted in this community

We were born here, we work here, and our neighbours are part of every tour. When you book with us, your money stays local.

  • Local stops

    We use family-run cafés, markets and workshops we know personally.

  • Fair for everyone

    Our friends and neighbours are paid properly for what they share with you.

  • Respectful travel

    We keep groups small so the places we love stay welcoming.
